checks.scope: knowledge listing/tombstones, ingestion validation/state, retrieval fusion/provenance
bounded process-local runner and safe readiness
canonical job state transitions/retry classification plus queued, running, published, failed, cancelled, shutdown, and cooperative cancellation behavior
authenticated API, lifecycle routes, negative security, OpenAPI body contract, chunked upload limit
temporary private storage -> bounded public queue -> canonical ingest -> refreshed deterministic retrieval
required routes plus explicit multipart and JSON request bodies

observed_invariants: Upload requires authenticated documents.upload permission before multipart parsing.
Client collection/workspace input only narrows the session-derived ACL scope.
Staging names are server-generated and storage is private temporary 0700/0600.
Published ingestion refreshes local retrieval; reindex prunes replaced points and delete tombstones metadata plus indexed points.
Public multipart/JSON upload returns a bounded queued job; cancellation is cooperative and can interrupt queued or running work.
Replacement and deletion failures use local compensation and fail-closed visibility gates; old published content is never retired before replacement publication.
Retry attempts are capped at three per failed/cancelled job and package/API job registries are finite.
Permanent input failures are non-retryable; transient infrastructure failures are explicitly retryable; published jobs are terminal and cannot be cancelled.
Public job/document/readiness payloads use whitelists and omit source text, paths, raw exceptions, credentials, and heartbeat internals.
The worker seam is explicitly process-local; production startup requires injected external identity and never seeds demo credentials.
note: Evidence is hermetic/local and supports implementation behavior only; it makes no production availability or latency claim.
